verdict.rationale: Jira's own feature docs say it offers progress reporting, such as burn down charts and cycle-time measurement, and give visibility on company progress. However, the pack never mentions building configurable dashboards or adding widgets, so only the reporting core of the story is evidenced, and only thinly. Missing for 10: documented dashboard creation, configurable widgets/gadgets, sharing or customizing dashboards, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can build dashboards and widgets to report on project progress

citations.quote: Keep work on track whether you're measuring engineering cycle time, burn down charts, or managing capacity.
Get visibility on your company's progress towards top priorities as projects advance
Stay up-to-date on the work's progress using the view you like: boards, lists, timeline, or calendars.
